chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: A Spikes Brothers novelty-act card from about 1909
summary: A printed card advertises the Spikes Brothers as novelty instrumentalists and originators of the Musical Meat Market.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: You just found this card that you say is about seventy years old, and it says, "Spikes Brothers, Novelty Instrumentalists, Originators of the Musical Meat Market," and there's a design--a very pretty design. Is that some of your art work there?
Oh, I don't know. I don't remember.

"Musical Instruments" up in the corner. "Permanent address," it says, "1488 West 35th Place, Los Angeles, California." And it says, "En route [blank] seasons 191 [blank]" This was so you could fill out...what? What was the 'en route' with a blank for? Just hand this out...?

Well, I guess, I don't know. My brother took all the busines. I guess that is a form we would say, maybe in Chicago, a certain date; New York, a certain date--if he was going to send it away or something. I don't know.
It's printed in a beautiful shade of deep reddish pur...what...magenta. Not quite magenta. Pretty color!
Yeah. That's about seventy years old. That was about 1909 and '10.
